verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at developer.vanta.com that indexes APIs, the MCP server and integration guides. Docs pages are served as .md files that point agents back to that index. Vanta also publishes agentskills.io-spec skill files and a docs MCP server that serves every docs page as a skill.md resource. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually using these agent-oriented docs in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.vanta.com/llms.txt # Vanta Developer Hub
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://developer.vanta.com/llms.txt
Vanta publishes agentskills.io-spec skill files that give your AI coding tool Vanta-specific guidance.
The MCP server at `https://developer.vanta.com/mcp` exposes search over the developer docs and serves every page as a `skill.md` resource.
